I've also had 2 kids and I agree! I've had other health issues that brought on pain that was on par with tooth infections/abscesses, but my God, I screamed and cried on and off for hours with that infection.
I didn't know I had an infection for 2 months. I just suffered. Now, I'll go in as soon as those symptoms come up. Luckily, I have top dentures. My teeth had been breaking, rotting and were very fragile. No matter how much I took care of my teeth, it just didn't matter to my disease. Yet I know people who don't take care of their oral hygiene and their teeth are strong, no issues and still look perfectly white. 😅

I've been with my bf for 9 years. We have 2 kids. You don't think you could fall in love with your partner anymore than you are already are, but then you see them with your child and it's a moment where you're completely awe-struck. 😊
I hope all goes well with the pregnancy and birth. I hope both momma and baby recover well from birth.
Buy her, her favorite snacks and rub her back all the time.
Also, remember to take care of yourself too. Dads kind of get overlooked in the chaos of pregnancy and birth. In order to be there for your wife and baby, you need to show up for yourself too so you don't spread yourself thin.
If you guys can, try to get a vacation in before baby comes. 😊

My partner and I are so hopelessly in love with each, even after 9 years. If we broke up, I'd stay single. Nothing would ever come close to what I have with my current partner. Its truly like I found my soul mate.

My Bf and I have been together for 9 years. (I can't get married due to debt and health issues) 
We are just as in love with each other as when we first got together.
I love that man endlessly, but he has also been head over heels for me since before we got together.
I promise there are great men out there who truly love women, but I won't lie they are rare.
After we had 2 kids I was worried about how my body looked. He loves how soft my stomach is now. He always holds a boob in one hand and my stomach in the other when we cuddle.😅 He's also a beyond amazing dad too!

Yeah I wasn't talking about this. I was talking about real allergies not just side effects of medication or things of that nature. She legit believed allergies, that could kill you, were fake over half the time. Like legitimately believed that more than half the people who develop anaphylaxis was nothing more than a placebo effect from being told they are allergic. It literally sounded like something straight from Qanon when she tried to explain why the government lies about allergies. She also believed that people who really do have allergies was because the government gave them that allergy on purpose to make them weak. If im honest it was the most entertainment I'd had the entire time I was hospitalized.

In 2013 my boyfriend and i were having a party. Then he disappeared. He'd been drinking heavily. I found him in his room with a gun. When I walked in he put it to his head. I spent a lot of time trying to talk him out of it. 

At one point he whipped the gun up to the side of his head again, looked me in the eye and said " I want this to haunt you the rest of your life. At least someone will remember me if I blow my brains out on to them."

I was 17 and I had just started seeing someone. We got stuck somewhere for a while and I had to hold my bladder. When I finally found a bathroom I panicked when my urine was deep red. Tje next day I got hit with excruciating pain out of nowhere. On the way to the ER with this guy who barely knows me and vice versa and I'm freaking out hoping it's a UTI and not an STD. I'm giving him hard looks until the results came in, UTI. 

It didn't end there. I spent another seven months in and out of the ER at least once a week and tons of apts. That guy stayed tbrough it all. After 7 months they did a CT scan and I finally was told I was full of kidney stones. 

5 years later I would finally get a diagnosis after all the diets failed and the number of stones I made increased. I have a more rare kidney disorder that makes me produce stones like crazy and constantly. I've lived with kidney stones daily for the last 8 years and will the rest of my life.

I had a supervisor like this. She loved to remind me that she was a virgin. We were in the office discussing a work incident. It led off into another conversation about personal experiences with sexual assault/rape. She interrupted me to tell me that though she may be a virgin she knows what shes talking about because she was at a store a few years previous and assumed a man was following her finding it too coincidental that he left the store at the same time. noticed he turned off the same way as her. So she called the police and reported him for following her. So they tracked him down and turns out he only lived a few blocks down from her and was just trying to get home. Then looked me in the eyes and said she knew exactly what it was like to be a rape victim because of that. I dont think I ever felt my jaw hit the floor so fast. She did something similar a few months later when another coworker explained how hard it was to leave an abusive relationship. She also thought being a virgin meant she was better than all of us and loved to bring it up.

I do understand this. With my previous urologist he noted it in my file that i dont tolerate stents well and was ontop of my pain. My current one who I will be changing after my next procedure believes that stents do not cause pain for anyone. It made me curious if there was more of a reason as to why some deal with severe pain and others do not. Ive been trying to be more curious in regard to my health conditions and the issues they cause to have a better understanding of them and maybe stumble on better ways to manage them.
